text:
maria: Quick UX review — proposed chart compactness change + unit clarity. dropping the long axis labels to 1 line and adding a small unit pill. thoughts? :thinking_face:

jake: can you paste the mock? curious how the unit pill looks with long legend entries

maria: here — Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xxx/chart-compactness (also attached screenshot)

olivia: first impression: unit pill helps, but when values are large the pill reads weird. e.g., 1.2M -> we currently show `M` but tooltip expands to "millions"

samir: agree with olivia. also worried about smoothing toggle placement — toggles at top feel distant from the series selector. maybe inline with legend? :thinking_face:

maria: proposal: 2-line legend max, unit pill right-aligned in axis header; smoothing toggle within chart toolbar next to export button. quick config snippet we tried:
```json
{
  "yAxis": {"labelMaxLines": 1, "unitPill": true, "unitText": "auto"},
  "legend": {"maxLines": 2, "compact": true},
  "toolbar": {"items": ["export","smoothingToggle"]}
}
```

jake: quick accessibility nit — if the unit is in a pill, ensure it has a screenreader label, e.g. `aria-label: \"Units: millions\"` so voiceover doesn't just read "pill"

olivia: also for keyboard nav: smoothing toggle should be reachable via tabbing order after the legend items. currently toolbar is after the chart in DOM which breaks flow.

maria: good call. we'll require: aria-label on pill, smoothing toggle as second focusable control in toolbar (after legend menu).

samir: outlier handling question: do we clip peaks or annotate them? current UX sometimes compresses scale and hides trends. suggestion: add an outlier flag (dot) with tooltip and an optional "cap max" mode in chart prefs.

jake: love outlier flag. microcopy for tooltip: "This point is an outlier (value: 12,345,678). Toggle cap to compress view." copy tweak maybe shorter: "Outlier: 12.3M — toggle cap to compress."

olivia: accessibility for outlier flags — ensure color is not sole indicator. add dashed border or icon and include textual annotation in the tooltip that screenreaders read by default.

maria: actionable list coming: 1) add aria-label to unit pill + expand on hover; 2) move smoothing toggle into toolbar and fix tab order; 3) legend max 2 lines, compact mode; 4) outlier flag + optional cap mode + microcopy variant; 5) keyboard/voicing acceptance tests.

designbot: created follow-up issue #2345: "axis compactness & outlier flagging — implement unit pill + smoothing toggle relocation" assigned to @maria and @samir.

samir: thanks — will prototype the outlier flag tonight, ping when ready for quick review. :thumbsup:

jake: tiny copy nit for axis unit pill: prefer `Units: USD` over `USD` when the axis is not obvious. less ambiguous for new users.

maria: noted. i'll put two copy variants in the prototype and we can A/B. posting updated screenshot soon.

olivia: thanks team — small follow-up: ensure chart export includes the axis copy in PNG for docs.

maria: added to checklist. closing thread after prototypes. :sparkles:
